hero.title: Build lasting AI capability — not another stalled pilot

hero.description: Setting up an Enterprise AI Lab is a business decision as much as a technology one. Done well, it accelerates useful products, shortens time from idea to value, and creates advantage that compounds. This page explains the blueprint in language executives and delivery teams can share.

phasedRollout.title: Phased Rollout Plan
phasedRollout.subtitle: A pragmatic 12-month timeline to go from zero to production

phases.title: Foundation
tasks: Secure executive sponsorship and funding approval
Hire core team (ML lead, 2 engineers, 1 MLOps)
Procure and install compute and storage hardware
Establish networking and security baselines
Set up development environments and toolchains

phases.title: Platform Build
tasks: Deploy Kubernetes cluster with GPU scheduling
Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows
Build data ingestion and feature store pipelines
Configure experiment tracking and model registry
Complete SOC 2 readiness assessment

phases.title: Pilot Projects
tasks: Launch 2-3 pilot ML projects with business units
Establish model deployment and monitoring workflows
Conduct bias and fairness audits on pilot models
Gather feedback and iterate on platform tooling
Expand team with data scientists and product manager

phases.title: Scale & Optimize
tasks: Promote pilot models to production serving
Implement automated retraining and drift detection
Onboard additional business units and use cases
Publish internal AI playbook and best practices
Present ROI report to leadership, plan Y2 expansion
